description: Create an empty board in the workspace, to leave the user a view of what you found; fill it with add_panel, where each panel says which projects it reads. Pass `expiresInDays` for a board built for one launch, so it deletes itself afterwards instead of staying forever. Only do this when the user asked for a board or agreed to one.

description.description: One sentence saying what the board is for, at most 100 characters. It is the line under the board's title; a person can edit it in Vinktar.

expiresInDays.description: Delete the board this many days from today. Leave it out for a board that stays. A person can change or clear the date in Vinktar.

name: create_board
title: Create board
